title: Improve error messages when there are no quantities to reverse in shipped/received lines in Sales/Purchase/Transfer
summary: Error messages when reversing shipped or received lines now distinguish between no reversible quantities and already-reversed lines, providing clearer guidance for users and AI agents.
key_points: An empty selection after filtering (for example only comment or blank lines) now raises a new, action-oriented error
The existing 'already reversed' error is kept only for lines that really are reversed
Fixes the misleading message first seen in Undo Return Shipment
Error messages are aligned across undo codeunits for sales, purchase, return and transfer documents
Tests updated for the new messages
quote: Message wording is action-oriented so both users and AI agents get a clear next step.
